title: Globe badge and inert local-path features on Remote Sessions
body:
Mark Remote Sessions with a small globe over the tab icon and the Sessions-panel row icon, with a tooltip naming the Remote. Make the features that assume a seat-PC path inert on them: file-path links, file drops and image paste. The close confirm names the Remote instead of a process tree.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-20-remote-sessions-design.md (sections: UI > Globe, UI > Inert on a Remote Session)
Blocked by: Open a Remote Session from the CLI with --on
Done when:
- the globe overlays the icon and the agent logo stays visible; local Sessions are unchanged
- URL links still open on a Remote Session; file-path links do nothing; a drop or image paste is refused with a toast
- closing a Remote Session with a running program shows a confirm that names the Remote
- the globe asset is a white silhouette tinted like the other icons
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent; then ask the human to run build-screenshot
